product.description:
Removing a radiator can often be a challenging and messy job. Many of us have experienced the frustration of water or sludge escaping from a radiator during removal, leading to stained carpets, damaged flooring, or costly cleaning and replacement bills. The Plumb Thumbs Radiator Capping Tools are a patented innovation designed to replace the old method of using your fingers or thumbs to seal radiator connections during removal.

These improved, double ended tool featuring both ½” (15mm) and ¾” (22mm), allowing radiators or towel rails to be removed quickly and easily — without draining the system. The radiator can remain full of water and sealed, completely preventing spills and protecting your floors from dirty water or sludge.

This D-shaped toilet seat measures approximately 425mm long × 360mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 280mm long × 212mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

product.name: Sentinel Leak Sealer 1L - Central Heating Radiator Boiler Pressure Fix
product.description:
Professional Grade Central Heating Protection The Sentinel Leak Sealer 1L is a high-performance internal leak sealer designed to protect your home from the damage and inconvenience of central heating leaks. Specifically formulated for both professional plumbing engineers and DIY enthusiasts, this liquid solution targets small, "invisible" leaks and weeping joints that are often impossible to locate manually. By sealing these gaps from the inside, it helps stabilize your system and stops the frustration of a constant boiler pressure drop.

Safe and Non-Clogging Technology Unlike lower-quality alternatives that can cause catastrophic blockages, Sentinel’s advanced formula is non-clogging. It circulates freely with the system water, forming a soft seal only when it comes into contact with the air at a leak site. This ensures that your radiators, valves, and expensive central heating pumps remain completely safe and operational while the leak is being addressed, often resulting in a quieter system.

Universal Compatibility Sentinel Internal Leak Sealer is compatible with all metals commonly found in UK heating systems, including steel, copper, and aluminium. It is also safe for use with all common elastomers used in seals and gaskets. For the best results, it can be used alongside a central heating inhibitor to provide long-term protection against both leaks and internal corrosion.

Application Made Simple There is no need for complex draining or expensive plumber call-outs. Simply add the solution to your system via the expansion tank on open systems or using a dosing vessel on sealed systems. One bottle is sufficient to treat a standard domestic system of up to 10 radiators. Within 24 hours of circulation, the formula will form a reliable seal, helping you avoid repair bills and ensuring your heating system remains at peak efficiency.

product.description:
Fernox F4 Express Leak Sealer is a fast-acting internal leak sealant for minor leaks in central heating systems. Specially designed for sealed  and combi systems, this 400ml solution works without the need to drain the system, saving time, water, and labour. It quickly locates and seals hidden micro-leaks in radiators, pipes, joints, and heat exchangers by forming a durable polymer seal wherever air ingress is detected.

This leak sealer is suitable for use with all standard central heating system materials and is safe for boilers, pumps, and valves. The air-powered solution can be applied directly into the system via a radiator, filling loop, or TF1 filter using the included universal adapter. With a treatment capacity of up to 130L of water (or 16 radiators), it is an efficient choice for household and light commercial systems.

Unlike traditional radiator sealants, Fernox F4 Express is environmentally responsible—it uses compressed air instead of chemical propellants and comes in a recyclable container. Ideal for heating engineers and DIY users alike, it helps prevent damage caused by water loss and pressure drops, offering a convenient stop leak solution until permanent repairs can be made.

For best results, ensure system cleanliness and avoid using in heavily sludged systems. Not suitable for repairing major leaks or burst pipes.

Traditionally, port wine was served in sipping pipes, which look like large glass Smoking pipes, such as this. product.name: KCT Universal Hose Clips - 5 pack 90-120mm 304 Stainless Steel Adjustable Metal Clamps for Air/Fuel/Water/Plumbing/Bath Pipes
product.description: The KCT 304 Stainless Steel Hose clips are a range of durable and versatile clips for use around the home, garden, and garage and up to the toughest of tasks. Each clip has a 9mm wide band that helps to create a tight seal around any type of pipe, tubing, or cable. The clips can be easily adjusted with the side-located screw fitting by using a screwdriver or ratchet wrench. product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Water Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 70m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Water Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground water pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant plastic mesh, it features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed warning text. The highly visible mesh helps identify buried water pipe routes when exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, it provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams, helping to identify underground services during construction and groundworks. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground water pipe routes before or during excavation. Its durable, rot-resistant construction is designed to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for service identification. Suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers, this detectable warning mesh provides a practical way to mark buried water pipes and improve visibility of underground services. Certified to EN 12613. PLEASE NOTE - Images are for illustrative purposes only.

product.name: 38mm to 51mm (1 1/2" To 2") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: Plumbright 15mm Compression Magnetic Scale Reducer PBM/15/CPS
product.description: Plumbright Magnetic Scale Reducers (MSR) can be used in both domestic and commercial properties. Magnetic Scale Reducers are recommended as single appliance protection installation. The MSR can be fitted vertically or horizontally and there is no preferred direction of flow. It includes simple compression fittings for easy connection to standard pipe. The MSR consists of a copper body with a permanent magnet inside. Magnetic Scale Reducers are installed to help prevent the build-up of limescale formation (mainly made from calcium carbonate) in appliances. By preventing limescale formation, the damaging potential reduction in operational life of the appliances and the costly drop in efficiency can both be reduced or minimised. An MSR creates a magnetic field which changes the crystal structure of calcium carbonate making it less likely to cluster as limescale on heat exchangers, elements and pipework.

The worm drive engages an embossed band 9mm wide and 0.7mm thick for fine, even tightening across the full clamping range, and the slim band keeps the clip low-profile once fitted. The clamping range is embossed on every band, so each size is easy to identify. A recommended tightening torque of 4.0 Nm (approx. 35 lbf in) guides correct fitting.

Clamping range: 190-210mm (7.48-8.27in)
Band and housing: stainless steel
Screw: zinc-plated steel, slotted hex head
Grade: W2
Band width: 9mm
Band thickness: 0.7mm
Recommended tightening torque: 4.0 Nm
Mechanism: worm drive
Pack size: 10

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 1m Straight Reinforced Hose Red - 68mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. Available in diameters from 13mm up to 152mm and supplied in 1-metre lengths, each hose provides a smooth internal bore for optimal flow and easy fitment. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend - 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° swivel bends create a tight-radius 45° change of direction in soil and waste systems. These spigot-to-socket solvent weld fittings have a long tail for insertion into another fitting and are supplied in a pack of two. Made from durable ABS, they are manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and are kitemarked. For solvent weld installation, clean pipe and fitting, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 12 hours before testing. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement. Solvent weld joints are permanent.

product.name: FloPlast Solvent Weld Waste Reducer 40mm x 32mm White Pack of 2

Made from durable ABS and supplied as a pack of two. To install, ensure pipe and fitting surfaces are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact, then wipe away excess cement and allow 12 hours before testing. product.name: FloPlast 90 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend M&F, 40mm White - Pack of 2
